mentions.name: Vaava
mentions.description: This app provides end-to-end encrypted data sync between connected apps and a WebRTC-based baby monitor feature that streams video and audio between two phones; recent work focuses on sync reliability and monitor stability, validated with reproducible multi-device test setups.
mentions.audience: Personal use; the author built it originally mainly for themselves.
mentions.source_excerpt: Vaava (https://vaava.app) , been tweaking the e2ee data sync between connected apps, and the webrtc based baby monitor feature stability.
mentions.author: jkantola

mentions.name: Vaava
mentions.description: Privacy-first baby tracker app for logging feeds, sleep, diapers, and growth, built with Flutter for iOS and Android. The paid tier includes end-to-end encrypted data syncing, and the latest release adds optional AI features.
mentions.source_excerpt: Mainly Vaava (https://vaava.app) privacy-first baby tracker for feeds, sleep, diapers, and growth. Flutter, iOS and Android. Recently finished up e2ee data syncing for the paid tier of the app. Most recent relaese also contains some optional AI features.
mentions.author: jkantola
